name: Paraguay (1811–1812)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, yellow and blue.
history: Horizontal red, yellow and blue tricolour used by the newly independent Paraguay from August 1811, one of several short-lived flags of the first year after the May Revolution of 1811. It was replaced on 15 August 1812 by a red, white and blue tricolour, the ancestor of the present flag.
